Capabilities also include image-to-video and text-to-video generation, digital avatar presenter videos, voiceovers, background music, and sound effects. The platform also supports searches for research papers, academic literature, citation relationships, and patent information; social media content and data queries for X (Twitter), YouTube, and TikTok; and searches for GitHub repositories, code, and developer documentation.E-commerce: Access data related to Douyin, TikTok Shop, Taobao, Tmall, 1688, Amazon, Shopee, Temu, and other platforms.
